defaultPolicy.description: A scene without a completed native pairing produces immutable artifacts and requires human classification; it cannot be treated as visually accepted.

systemRenderingExceptions: Liquid Glass refraction and blur may differ only inside a reviewer-approved mask recorded with the scene evidence.
Font rasterization anti-aliasing may differ by at most the configured low-amplitude exact-pixel allowance; glyph metrics, wrapping, baseline and accessibility labels remain strict.
humanReviewCriteria: Verify text content, order, wrapping, baseline and accessible label against the official DOM/ARIA record.
Verify layout anchors, column widths, component bounds, spacing, focus order and disabled/enabled control state against the official capture.
Classify every remaining material diff as a native implementation defect or a documented system-rendering exception; do not use a generic platform exception.
Attach official image, native image, amplified diff, report JSON and written classification to the matching TODO evidence before marking a UI task complete.
